pictures.name: flat_topped_mountain
pictures.scene: one broad flat topped mountain of grey rock standing alone above a plain, its lowest slopes lit warm gold by a rising sun, its great bulk above holding steady and dark against a wide pale sky

pictures.name: ring_of_hills
pictures.scene: a wide bowl of quiet land held on every side by a ring of low hills, the near grass lit warm along the bottom of the frame, the encircling ridges beyond it soft and blue and almost without detail

pictures.name: broken_staff
pictures.scene: a heavy carved staff lying snapped in two on dry stony ground, its splintered ends catching hard low light at the bottom of the frame, the bare land beyond it running away flat into dull shadow

pictures.name: boundary_stones
pictures.scene: a line of old boundary stones standing undisturbed along the edge of a quiet field, the nearest of them lit warm and low, the ripening grain beyond them still and dim under a heavy evening sky

pictures.name: open_barley_field
pictures.scene: a wide field of standing barley bending all one way in a soft wind, its nearest heads lit gold along the bottom of the frame, the depth of the field beyond going quiet and dark toward a far treeline

pictures.name: crooked_track
pictures.scene: a faint winding track twisting away across broken salt ground toward nothing, its nearest ruts lit hard and low, the waste beyond it emptying out into a flat grey haze without any horizon

pictures.name: evening_over_the_fold
pictures.scene: a low drystone sheepfold on a quiet hillside with its gate standing open, the wall lit soft and warm along the bottom of the frame, the hill above it settling into a still blue evening

lines.text: Those who trust in the LORD are like Mount Zion.
It cannot be moved; it abides forever.
so the LORD surrounds His people,
For the scepter of the wicked will not rest
upon the land allotted to the righteous,
so that the righteous will not put forth
Do good, O LORD, to those who are good,
and to the upright in heart.
But those who turn to crooked ways
the LORD will banish with the evildoers.
